nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by floury white urination; bristling during micturition; profuse urination; whitish urination.

nodes.label_en: Polyuria disorder with urine associated with froth
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by micturating in small quantities rapidly; transparent clear urination; frothy micturition.

nodes.label_en: Polyuria disorder due to vitiated pitta
Polyuria disorder with urine resembling alkaline water
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: urine resembling alkaline liquid by odour, colour, taste and touch.

nodes.label_en: Polyuria disorder with urine resembling black ink
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by the passage of urine resembling black ink; profuse urination; elimination of urine which is hot in nature.
A disorder characterized by passage of bluish urine; frothy micturition; transparent; sour taste.

nodes.label_en: Polyuria disorder with urine mixed with blood
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by urine smelling like raw flesh; urine tasting like saline; reddish urine; elimination of urine which is hot in nature; passage of blood with urine.

nodes.label_en: Polyuria disorder with urine resembling Rubia cordifolia decoction
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by passage of urine resembling Rubia cordifolia decoction; profuse urination; urine smelling like raw flesh.

nodes.label_en: Polyuria disorder with urine resembling turmeric water
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by passage of acrid urine; passage of turmeric-coloured urine; burning micturition.

nodes.label_en: Polyuria disorder with urine smelling and tasting like acidic substance
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by sour-smelling urine; sour- tasting urine.

nodes.label_en: Polyuria disorder due to vitiated vata
Polyuria disorder with urine resembling muscle fat
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by recurrent passage of urine; passage of urine having a fatty appearance; passage of fat-mixed urine.

nodes.label_en: Polyuria disorder with urine resembling bone marrow
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by passage of urine mixed with bone marrow; passage of urine resembling bone marrow; recurrent passage of urine.

nodes.label_en: Polyuria disorder with uncontrolled passage of urine; urinary incontinence
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: urinary incontinence; described as passing urine like an unrestrained elephant in rut; urine flow is weak and obstructed but continuous in nature; occurring without any voluntary effort from the patient; consistency of urine slimy as if mixed with lymph.

nodes.label_en: Polyuria disorder with urine resembling honey
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: passage of astringent urine; passage of sweet urine; passage of nonunctuous urine; pale urine; urine resembling honey; honey-coloured urine.

nodes.label_en: Carbuncle resembling earthenware vessel with flat cover
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a boil with raised margins; bluish-black lesions; accompanied by wetness/dampness; pain; resembling an earthen saucer; a boil with a depressed centre.

A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a boil accompanied by a severe burning sensation; a boil surrounded by a fleshy mass network; numbness; covered with venous plexus; unctuous discharge; broad-cavity nodule; with severe pain; needling type of pain in nodule; minute opening; covered with a venous plexus .

nodes.label_en: Carbuncle character- ized by large size and blue-coloured lesion
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a blue-coloured boil; deep-rooted on back; deep-rooted on abdomen; painful eruption; moistening/ soddening eruption; large vesicular swelling.

nodes.label_en: Carbuncle character- ized by reddish white blisters
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a raised boil with burning skin; excessive thirst; confusion/delirium; fever; uninterrupted spread/spreads more at night; pain resembles being burnt with fire; severely painful; spreading in nature; reddish eruptions; blackish; with blisters; burning sensation; hard boil or piḍaka; white-colour on eruption.

nodes.label_en: Carbuncle character- ized by lesions resembling white mustard seeds
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a not very big boil suppurating quickly; very painful; resembling a heap of white mustard seed- sized eruptions.

nodes.label_en: Carbuncle surrounded by multiple small boils
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by a large-sized boil which is studded with multiple small boils; large vesicular swelling; covered with numerous eruptions.

nodes.label_en: Carbuncle charac- ter-ized by lesions resembling green gram
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by a boil similar in size to a lentil.

nodes.label_en: Carbuncle characterized by lesions resembling the tuber Pueraria tuberosa
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by a hard boil similar to the tuber Pueraria tuberosa or vidārīkanda.

A disorder defined by excessive body mass and characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: decreased life expectancy; decreased sexual potency; snoring due to obstructed respiration; voracious appetite; dyspnoea on exertion; thirst; bad odour; tendency of fat to accumulate in the abdomen and bones; confusion/delirium; bodily exhaustion or tiredness; sleepiness; sweating; vigour not in proportion to body bulk; pendulous breasts; pendulous buttocks; pendulous abdomen.

nodes.label_en: Generalized abdominal enlargement due to ascites or other localized reason
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: bodily exhaustion or tiredness/inability to perform physical activities; abdominal distension; inability to walk; drowsiness/lassitude; burning sensation; diminution of agni; sluggish passage of faeces; weakness; retention of flatus; oedema; gurgling intestinal sounds/borborygmi; pedal oedema; oedema in hands; diminution of agni; shiny and glossy cheeks; dryness of palate; dryness of lips; inability to do physical work; loss of strength; inability to take/digest food; emaciated/thin/malnourished; swollen abdomen; person resembling a dead body.

nodes.label_en: Abdominal enlarge- ment due to vitiated vata
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: abdominal oedema; oedema in hands; oedema in legs; cracking of abdominal skin; fluctuating abdominal oedema; pain in abdomen; pain in sides of chest/ flanks; upward movement of vāta; generalized body aches; breaking type of pain in small joints; dry cough; emaciation; weakness; loss of taste; indigestion; heaviness in lower abdomen; suppression of flatus; obstruction to elimination of urine; retention of faeces/constipation; blackish nails; blackish eyes; blackish face; blackish urine; blackish skin; blackish faeces; slightly reddish nails; slightly reddish eyes; slightly reddish face; slightly reddish urine; slightly reddish skin; slightly reddish faeces; thin veins spread across the abdomen; blackish veins spread across the abdomen; abdomen on percussion sounds like a distended leather bag; upward movement of vayu with pain; downward movement of vayu with pain; random movement of vayu with pain; upward movement of vayu with sound; downward movement of vayu with sound; random movement of vayu with sound; scrotal oedema; low back pain; pricking type of pain in abdomen; breaking type of pain in abdomen; in side of chests/flanks;in back; in umbilical region; blackish veins spread on painful distended abdomen with abdominal sounds.

nodes.label_en: Abdominal enlarge- ment due to vitiated pitta
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a burning sensation; fever; thirst; syncope or swooning; diarrhoea; giddiness or dizziness; pungent taste in mouth; greenish discoloration of nails; greenish eyes; greenish discoloration of face; greenish discoloration of urine; greenish discoloration of skin; greenish discoloration of faeces; yellowish discoloration of nails; yellowish discoloration of eyes; yellowish discoloration of face; yellowish discoloration of urine; yellowish discoloration of skin; yellowish discoloration of faeces; bluish veins over abdomen; yellowish veins over abdomen; turmeric-coloured veins over abdomen; greenish veins over abdomen; coppery-coloured veins over abdomen; burning sensation over abdomen; smoky sensation in abdomen; pain in abdomen; burning sensation in abdomen; resembling fomentation of abdomen; wetness of abdomen; soft to touch; quickly leading to ascites or jalodara; sucking type of pain; associated with thirst; associated with fever; associated with burning sensation; quickly increasing in size; pungent taste in mouth.

nodes.label_en: Abdominal enlarge- ment due to vitiated kapha
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: numbness; heaviness; loss of taste; indigestion; generalized body aches; oedema/swelling in hands; oedema/swelling in legs; scrotal oedema; swelling in thighs; nausea/provocation of dosha; sleep; breathlessness/ difficulty in breathing; cough; white discoloration of nails; white discoloration of eyes; white discoloration of body; white discoloration of urine; white discoloration of faeces; whitish- coloured veins spread across the abdomen; abdominal area cold to touch; heaviness of abdomen; steady swelling; unctuous in nature; huge swelling; with body pain; increasing over a long time; generalized oedema; feeling of being wrapped in a wet cloth; smooth to touch; huge swelling; hard swelling.

nodes.label_en: Abdominal enlarge- ment due to vitiated tridosha
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: nails of different colours; eyes of different colours; different colours appear on face; urine of different colours; skin of different colours; faeces of different colours; abdominal linings of different colours; veins over abdomen of different colours; aggravation of features on cold and windy days; aggravation of features on cloudy days; burning sensation; constant syncope/fainting; pallor/pale; emaciated/ thin/malnourished; dryness due to thirst; severe form of disease; dreadful; quickly leading to ascites or jalodara.

nodes.label_en: Abdominal enlarge- ment due to enlarged plīha (splenomegaly)
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: progressive enlargement of the spleen, debility, lack of taste in mouth, indigestion, constipation, retention of urine, darkness in front of the eyes, excessive thirst, body ache, vomiting, transient loss of consciousness, tiredness in the body parts, cough, dyspnea, mild fever, flatulence, loss of appetite, emaciation, abnormal taste in the mouth, pain in joint of the digits, abdominal pain due to morbid vata, abnormal pinkish coloration of the abdomen, discoloration of the abdominal wall; abdominal wall showing bluish-greenish-yellowish linear stretch marks.

nodes.label_en: Abdominal enlargement due to obstructed bowels
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: thirst; burning sensation; fever; dryness of mouth; dryness of palate; fatigue in thighs; cough; breathlessness/difficulty in breathing; weakness; loss of taste; indigestion; suppression of faeces; obstructed elimination of urine; abdominal distension; vomiting; sneezing; headache; precordial pain/cardiac pain; pain in umbilical region; anal pain; obstructed flatus; rigid abdomen; reddening of abdomen; bluish striae over abdomen; bluish veins over abdomen; no striae; cow-tail protrusion of umbilicus; impacted stools in rectum/anus; passage of scanty faeces with difficulty; increased abdominal swelling between heart and umbilicus in epigastric region; faecal odour of abdomen.

nodes.label_en: Acute abdominal swelling caused by intestinal perforation
nodes.definition: An acute and life threatening illness characterized by increased abdominal distension below the umbilicus; passing of blackish stools; passing of bluish stools; passing of yellowish stools; passing of slimy stools; passing of stools smelling of dead body; passing of unformed stools with ama; hiccups; breathlessness/difficulty in breathing; cough; thirst; excessive urination; loss of taste; indigestion; weakness; watery discharge from anus; severe needling type of pain; indigestion; frequent scanty stool-coloured discharge from anus; giddiness or dizziness; tearing.

A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a feeling of heaviness; unstable/inconsistent/ shifting in nature; swelling; warmth; prominence of vessels; horripilation; discoloration; swelling between tvak and māṃsa.

A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: migratory oedema/shifting in nature; shiny/ thin skin; rough/dry skin; slightly reddish swelling; blackish oedema; numbness; hyperaesthesia; pain; subsiding on its own; pitting on pressure and quickly refilling; increasing in daytime; soft oedema; shifting pain; various types of pain including pricking sensation or splitting pain; dry oedema; rough hairs; contractions; pulsatile; quick increase and decrease; relieved by snigdha treatment; relieved by hot treatment; relieved by massage; less swelling at night; irritation of skin (as if smeared with mustard paste).

A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: soft oedema; with odour; blackish oedema; yellowish oedema; oedema with redness; giddiness or dizziness; fever; sweating; thirst; intoxication; hotness; tenderness/pain on touch; red eyes; severe inflammation; yellow-reddish oedema; rapidly spreading/rapidly remitting; symptoms such as burning sensation with sweating and restlessness; coppery hairs; occurring first in mid-part of body; severe burning sensation; heat/fever; moistening/ soddening; desire for cold; altered faeces/loose motions; tenderness/inability to tolerate touch.

A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: massive oedema; firm oedema; whitish in colour; loss of taste; excessive salivation; sleep; vomiting; diminution of agni; prolonged onset and subsiding with difficulty; pitting on pressure and not quickly refilling; more prominent at night; itching; whitish hairs; hard oedema; cold in nature; oily appearance; soft oedema; thick/dense swelling; no bleeding on incision; oozing of serous fluid for a long time after incision; desire to touch at site; desire for heat; slowly spreading.

nodes.label_en: Oedema due to any two vitiated dosha
Oedema due to vitiation of three dosha
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by various colours on the nails; stretch marks; varied colours on the abdomen and other body parts.

A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: severe heat; reddish-coloured oedema/ haematoma; generally clinical features of pittaja type; soft oedema; with odour; blackish oedema; yellowish oedema; oedema with redness; rapidly spreading/rapidly remitting; symptoms such as burning sensation with sweating and restlessness; coppery hairs; occurring first in mid-part of body; severe burning sensation.

A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: oedema in the dependent parts; migratory oedema/shifting in nature; burning sensation; soft oedema; painful; oedema developing rapidly.
A disorder characterized by penile and scrotal swelling; roughness; dryness.
A disorder characterized by blackish blisters; breaking type of pain; pricking pain; pulsating sensation.
A disorder characterized by fever; swelling resembling ripe fig fruit or udumbara; severe burning sensation; rapid suppuration; pain of pitta type-ośa coṣa; excessive moistness/soddening.
A disorder characterized by being associated with a burning sensation; swelling with itching; hard swelling; unctuous swelling; dull aching pain; cold swelling.

nodes.label_en: Hydrocoele due to predominance of vitiated blood
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by heavy swelling of scrotum accompanied by copious whitish dense discharge.

nodes.label_en: Hydrocoele due to predominance of vitiated fat
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by clinical features of all types of dosha; cracking of penile skin; appearance of kṛmi; scrotal oedema; severe pain; undergoing rapid suppuration.

nodes.label_en: Hydrocoele due to predominance of vitiated urine
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by discharges of various colours; pain of different types; death; black blisters; severe bleeding; features of the pittaja variety.

A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: frequent entry of the intestines from the abdomen into scrotum and their exit (through inguinal canal); may be associated with fever; burning sensation; dryness/ wasting/emaciation.

A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: swelling of anterior side of the neck; single swelling; swelling demonstrating symptoms of vata and kapha; localized swelling; growing in size with time; swelling hangs like a scrotum in the neck; big or small swelling in the neck; excessive pain.

A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: pricking pain (todaḥ); full of blackish veins; covered with black striae; blackish swelling; slightly reddish swelling; bluish black swelling; after a while becoming unctuous; painless; hard swelling; taking a long time to increase; nonsuppurative; occasionally suppurating; sometimes suppurating; unpleasant taste in mouth; dryness of palate; dryness of throat.

A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: fixed swelling; swelling of normally coloured skin; heavy swelling in throat; associated with severe itching; cold swelling; very big swelling; suppurating after a long time; mild pain; sweetness in mouth; palate feeling as if coated; throat feeling as if coated.

nodes.label_en: Goitre due to predomi- nance of fat

nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: flesh-coloured nodular swellings on the neck which are hard; unctuous; brinjal-shaped; deep; some undergoing ripening and causing mild pain; some exuding fluid and causing severe itching; some disappearing; some reappearing; chronic in nature; glands resembling Zizyphus jujuba fruit (aproximately 2.5 to 6 cm), Piper chaba fruit (up to 7 cm) and Embelica officinalis fruit (2 to 2.5 cm). The closest diagnosis is tuberculous lymphadenitis.

A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: stable/immobile swelling; round swelling; elongated prominent swelling; smooth glandular swelling; swelling with mild pain; Amalaka-sized swellings; swelling resembling fish egg; accumulation of same colour; numerous; itching; mild pain; reaching the suppuration stage; undergoing destruction over time; becoming chronic.
A disorder characterized by raised swelling; knotted swelling; rounded swelling.

nodes.label_en: Nodular swelling, cyst due to vitiated vata
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a feeling of stretching; distress; pricking pain; a tearing type of pain associated with a cutting sensation; sensation of rending; blackish swelling; hard swelling; distended like the urinary bladder or basti; clear blood discharge on bursting; swelling abruptly increasing and decreasing; soft swelling.

nodes.label_en: Nodular swelling, cyst due to vitiated pitta
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: severe burning; fuming sensation; sucking type of pain; inflammation/suppuration; feeling of being burnt up; reddish swelling; yellow swelling; profuse; warm and bloody discharge; rapidly suppurating.

nodes.label_en: Nodular swelling, cyst due to vitiated kapha
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: cold swelling; goat-coloured swelling; swelling with mild pain; swelling with excessive itching; swelling of stony consistency; increasing over a long period of time; discharging thick white pus on bursting; painless micturition; body-coloured swelling.

nodes.label_en: Nodular swelling, cyst due to afflicted adipose tissue
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a swelling which increases or decreases as the body mass increases or decreases; unctuous swelling; large swelling; swelling with mild pain; associated with excessive itching sensation; on bursting discharge resembles an oil-cake or ghee; soft swelling; mobile swelling; on bursting thick coppery black-coloured meda discharge.

nodes.label_en: Nodular swelling, cyst of vascular origin
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by a raised round swelling; nonpulsatile nodule; painless micturition.

nodes.label_en: Nodular swelling, cyst due to vitiation of blood
nodes.definition: A disorder characterized by numbness and features of pitta-predominant cyst: severe burning; fuming sensation; sucking type of pain; inflammation/suppuration; feeling of being burnt up; reddish swelling; yellow swelling; profuse; warm and bloody discharge; rapidly suppurating.

A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: deep-rooted elevation of muscle; slowly growing and nonsuppurating swelling; slightly painful swelling; broad and deep-rooted swelling; round swelling; fixed swelling.

A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: profuse bleeding; nonsuppurative; rapid growth; raised; larger in size; pallor; fleshy projections forming bulky growth; with discharge.

A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: unctuousness; large in size; hard in nature; covered with sirā/venous plexus; same colour as skin; nonsuppurating; stony hard; fixed swelling; painless.
Development of a new tumour at the site of an existing one, or over the site of an old tumour which has been treated and resolved.
Development of a new tumour in the body while another one persists or simultaneous development of more than one tumour lesion.

A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: painful swelling associated with fever; swelling usually affects the limbs; preponderantly the lower limbs with an origin in the groin and spreading to legs.

Filariasis characterized by swelling which is rough to touch; black-coloured swelling; rough oedema; excessive cracks; severe pain; onset of pain without cause; frequent attacks of fever; peeling of skin.
Filariasis characterized by a yellowish-coloured swelling; soft swelling; fever; burning sensation.

Filariasis characterized by a whitish-coloured swelling; glossy swelling; mild pain; heavy in nature; huge swelling; associated with thorn-like projections; heavy swelling in the inguinal region and foot; associated with muscular growths; pale swelling in the inguinal region and foot; heavy swelling; hard swelling in the inguinal region and foot.

A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a deep-seated swelling which is broad-based; painful and round or else elongated, located in the bones and affecting skin; blood; muscles and fat; with the gradual production of excessively severe inflammatory swelling due to vitiated dosha. Generally, the condition advances to an open ulcer.

A type of abscess characterized by black swelling; slightly red-coloured swelling; rough oedema; excessively severe pain; varied types of onset and suppuration; thin watery discharge; less unctuous discharge; slightly reddish-coloured discharge; blackish-coloured discharge; frothy discharge; penetrating type of pain; cutting type of pain; giddiness or dizziness; borborygmi with distension; sound from swelling; pulsating sensation; spreading nature of swelling; blackish discoloration of swelling; irregular appearance.

A type of abscess characterized by a swelling resembling ripe fig-fruit or udumbara; blackish colour of swelling; fever; producing a burning sensation; rapid onset and suppuration; yellowish discharge; discharge resembling sesame seeds or tila; discharge resembling black gram or māṣa; discharge resembling kulatthodakaḥ; thirst; confusion/delirium; intoxication; reddish swelling; coppery-coloured swelling.

A type of abscess characterized by a swelling resembling an earthen saucer; pallor; cold; stiffness; mild pain; develops slowly and suppurates after a long time; whitish discharge; slimy discharge; profuse discharge; excessive/copious discharge; itching; yawning; nausea/provocation of dosha; loss of taste; heaviness.

A type of abscess characterized by a swelling of variegated colours; various types of pain; associated with varied discharges; markedly raised; uneven and extensive; irregular nature; broad/extensive; suppurating irregularly; mixed features.

A type of abscess characterized by a swelling covered with black blisters; blackish discoloration; severe burning sensation; painful; fever; features of paittika abscess; swelling resembling ripe fig-fruit or udumbara; blackish colour of swelling; fever; producing a burning sensation; rapid onset and suppuration; yellowish discharge; discharge resembling sesame seeds or tila; discharge resembling black gram or māṣa; discharge resembling kulatthodakaḥ; thirst; confusion/ delirium; intoxication; reddish swelling; coppery- coloured swelling.

A condition characterized by widespread or nodular (localized) inflammation; regular or irregular; due to accumulation of vitiated dosha in the skin and muscles which may manifest in any part of the body. May develop independently leading to ulcer formation at a later stage or be preceded by vidradhi (abscess).

nodes.label_en: Pre-ulcerative inflammation due to vitiated vāta
nodes.definition: A condition characterized by a black-coloured swelling; slightly reddish-coloured swelling; roughly indurated swelling; soft oedema; nonfixed/movable swelling; pricking pain; breaking pain; cutting type of pain.

nodes.label_en: Pre-ulcerative inflammation due to vitiated pitta
nodes.definition: A condition characterized by a yellowish-coloured swelling; soft oedema; reddish swelling; rapid onset of suppuration; severe burning sensation; smoky/fuming sensation.

nodes.label_en: Pre-ulcerative inflammation due to vitiated kapha
nodes.definition: A condition characterized by a pale swelling; hard swelling; cold swelling; unctuous swelling; delayed onset of suppuration; itching; heaviness; numbness.

nodes.label_en: Pre-ulcerative inflammation due to vitiated tridosha
nodes.definition: A condition characterized by a reddish swelling; soft oedema; roughly indurated swelling; nonfixed/movable swelling; soft oedema; hard swelling; unctuous swelling; cold swelling; suppuration without delay; suppuration taking a long time; pricking pain; breaking pain; cutting type of pain; burning sensation; severe burning sensation; smoky/fuming sensation; itching; heaviness; numbness.

nodes.label_en: Pre-ulcerative inflammation due to vitiated rakta
nodes.definition: A condition characterized by yellowish-coloured swelling; soft oedema; reddish swelling; rapid onset of suppuration; intensely black-coloured swelling; burning sensation; smoky/ fuming sensation.

A condition characterized by suppuration without delay; yellowish-coloured swelling; black-coloured swelling; bloody red-coloured swelling; soft oedema; reddish swelling; burning sensation; severe burning sensation; intensely black- coloured swelling.

An ulcer is an open sore on an external or internal surface of the body; caused by a break in the skin or mucous membrane which fails to heal; ranging from small; painful sores in the mouth to bedsores and serious lesions of the stomach or intestine.
An ulcer developing due to endogenous factors, i.e. vitiation of dosha.

An ulcer characterized by blackish discoloration; slightly reddish discoloration; thin wound; slimy; cold to touch; reduced quantity of discharge; dry; margins tending to crack/ crackling noise in ulcer; pulsating sensation; stretching; pricking pain; piercing/breaking pain; devoid of muscular tissue; hard on palpation; severe pain; colour resembling bhasma; colour resembling a pigeon; resembling mastu; colour resembling water used to wash flesh; intense pain.

An ulcer characterized by its sudden appearance; yellowish discoloration; bluish discoloration; oozing resembling palasha flower washings; warm discharge; burning sensation; causing inflammation/suppuration; dreadful-looking; yellowish pustules; thirst; confusion/delirium; fever; soddened wound/ ulcer with burning sensation; cracking of wound margins; putrid-smelling wound; putrid-smelling discharge; greyish- coloured; brownish-coloured; exudation of urine-like discharge; excessive/copious discharge; discharge resembling ash mixed water; discharge resembling oil; pain as if burned by alkali.

An ulcer characterized by constant severe itching; thick wound margins; covered with rigid membranous vessels and ligamentous tissue; rigid (base); pale appearance; mild pain; whitish discharge; dense copious discharge; cold discharge; excessive slimy discharge; feeling of heaviness; thick/dense discharge; mild pain; feeling of being wrapped in a wet cloth; mild soddening only; taking a long time to suppurate.

An ulcer characterized by resembling a collection of corap sprouts; covered with black vesicles; covered with black eruptions; covered with black network-like structures; smells like horses’ stable; associated with pain; fuming sensation; bloody discharge; sudden onset; yellowish discoloration; bluish discoloration; oozing resembling palasha flower washings; warm discharge; burning sensation; causing inflammation/suppuration; dreadful-looking; yellowish pustules; pricking pain; burning sensation; smoky/fuming sensation; yellowish or reddish in appearance with a similarly coloured discharge; discharge of pus tinged with blood.

An ulcer characterized by putrid discharge mixed with blood; pus discharge mixed with blood; excessively vitiated bloody discharge; deep-rooted ulcer; chronic ulcer; offensive putrid odour; every feature contrasting with a clean wound; minuscule wound opening; very broad wound opening; very hard on palpation; very soft; raised wound; deep-based wound; excessively cold wound; excessively hot wound; wound coloured other than black; red; yellow or white; gruesome-looking; wound raised like a fleshy protuberance; filled with putrid pus; filled with flesh; filled with sinew; filled with numerous blood vessels; disagreeable-looking; disagreeable smell; excessive pain; excessive burning sensation; excessive suppuration; excessive redness; excessive itching; excessive swelling; impure blood discharge; not healing for a long time; deviating from the normal direction.

An ulcer resembling the tongue surface; excessively soft; glossy; and moist; mild or no pain; healing in the normal pattern; without any discharge; no tridosha signs or symptoms; bluish-coloured edges; nodular appearance of wound base; slightly raised mid-portion; slightly red-coloured; slightly pale-coloured; not having blackish discoulration; not overly raised; nondepressed base.
An ulcer characterized by pigeon-coloured margins; no internal discharge; fixed to underlying tissue; flaky surface.
An ulcer characterized by healed edges; no indurated swelling; nonoedematous ulcer; painless ulcer; ulcer of same colour as skin; level with skin.
Various types of ulcers caused by external injury or trauma.

An injury to living tissue caused by a cut; blow or other impact; typically, one in which the skin is cut or broken Types: incised or surgical wound; stab injury or wound; puncture wound; lacerated wound; contused wound; abrasion.
A wound characterized by a pricking sensation; numbness; heaviness; excessive sensation of being struck; oedema; severe pain; patient always protecting the affected part.

A condition characterized by marked swelling; inability to bear movement or rotation and touch; crepitus on squeezing; looseness of parts; appearance of various types of pain; no relief of pain in any posture
Fracture with dislocation is characterized by swelling around the joints; pain increasing at night; swelling on both sides; onset of various types of pain at night.
A derangement or incomplete dislocation of joints characterized by mild swelling; persistent pain; derangement of the joints.
A lateral dislocation of a joint characterized by lateral displacement of the joint; deformity; pain.
A dislocation of a joint characterized by one of the bones being obliquely displaced; severe pain.
A dislocation characterized by loosening or dislocation of joints; severe joint pain.
A fracture characterized by multiple fractures with comminuted bone pieces; associated with pain.
A fracture characterized by distension and a sensation of being filled with bristles; multiple cracks on bone.

A wound characterized by an excessive flow of pus; appearance of pus via a tubular pathway in vrana; discharge appearing from a tube. When a suppurated abscess goes untreated, pus accumulates in the affected area and enters skin, with muscle and blood tissues forming a tract owing to vitiated tridosha or each dosha separately.

nodes.label_en: Deep ulcer with fistula formation due to vitiated vāta
nodes.definition: A sinus ulcer characterized by small, indurated opening; pain; frothy discharge; greater discharge at night; discoloured discharge.

nodes.label_en: Deep ulcer with fistula formation due to vitiated pitta
nodes.definition: A sinus ulcer characterized by thirst; burning sensation; pricking pain; exhaustion; fever; tearing sensation; excessive warm discharge; excessive yellow discharge; putrid pus discharge.

nodes.label_en: Deep ulcer with fistula formation due to vitiated kapha
nodes.definition: A sinus ulcer characterized by an excessive/copious discharge; thick/dense discharge; whitish-coloured discharge; slimy discharge; discharge at night; associated with mild pain; hard in nature; associated with itching; stiffness; excessive soddening during the night.

nodes.label_en: Deep ulcer with fistula formation due to vitiated dosha
nodes.definition: A sinus ulcer characterized by a burning sensation; fever; breathlessness/difficulty in breathing; syncope or swooning; dryness of mouth; fatal; like the night of death.

nodes.label_en: Deep ulcer with fistula formation due to injury with foreign body
nodes.definition: A sinus ulcer characterized by a frothy clear discharge as if churned; sanguineous discharge; warm discharge; constant pain; blood-mixed pus discharge; thin discharge; reduced quantity of discharge, e.g. pilonidal sinus.

nodes.definition: “Bheṣaja” is a comprehensive term representing different treatment approaches in the direct administration of medi- cines. It is also used to indicate a remedy, medicine, medica- ment, drug or incantation, and is generally considered to have two modes: one which bestows well-being in healthy individu- als and the other which alleviates diseases.

nodes.label_en: Substance with properties aligned to the five basic elements in its composition
nodes.definition: Substance with properties aligned to the five basic elements in its composition as deducted from its perceivable attri- butes such as taste and qualities. Although barley and wheat possess the properties of sweetness and heaviness (which ideally should alleviate vata), wheat alleviates vata while barley aggravates it. In this instance, wheat is an example of a substance with properties aligned to the five basic elements in its composition .

nodes.label_en: Substance with prop- erties inconsistent with the five basic elements in its composition
nodes.definition: Substance with properties inconsistent with the five basic elements in its composition as deducted from its perceivable attributes such as taste and qualities. Although barley and wheat possess the properties of sweetness and heaviness (which ideally should alleviate vata), wheat alleviates vata while barley aggravates it. In this instance, barley is an exam- ple of a substance with properties inconsistent with the five basic elements in its composition

nodes.label_en: Five pharmaco- therapeutic principles of substance
nodes.definition: The five pharmaco-therapeutic principles of substances are taste, quality, potency, post-digestion taste, and unique thera- peutic action.

There are six tastes: sweet, sour, salty, pungent, bitter and astringent. The term also indicates the fundamental structural component of primary circulating nutrient fluid (rasadhatu) as well as mercury.

nodes.definition: Purifying mercury for medicinal use involves eight processes which need to be applied consecutively in a specific sequence. They include svedanam, mardanam, murchanam, utthapanam, patanam, rodhanam, niyamanam and dipanam/ samdipanam.

nodes.definition: An assay of calcinated minerals based on the following criteria: verifying microfine nature by flotation on water (varitara), filling in the flexor creases of the hand (rekhapurnata), non-lustrous nature (nischandra) and non-reversal to metallic state (niruttha, apunarbhava).

A traditional oven using 1000 cow-dung cakes to produce heat for the calcination or incineration (bhasma) of mica, zinc and iron.

nodes.label_en: Traditional oven using 500 cow dung cakes

nodes.label_en: Group of key substances used in the processing of mercury
nodes.definition: A group of eight minerals used in the processing of mercury: 1. abhrakam, 2. vaikrantam, 3. makshikam, svarnamakshikam, 4. vimalam, 5. shilajatu, 6. sasyaka, tuttha, 7. capala and 8. rasaka, kharpara; considered to have superior properties to other minerals.

Biotite [iron mica (black) or ferro-magnesium mica: (HK)2(MgFe)2(AlFe)2(SiO4)3]. In calcinated form abhrakam is used as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral formulations.
Calcium fluoride (CaF2). In calcinated form vikrantam is used as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral formulations.
Copper iron sulfide (Cu2Fe2S4). In calcinated form makshikam is used as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral formulations.
Ferrous disulfide (FeS2). In calcinated form vimalam is used as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral formulations.
Black bitumen in powder form is used as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo- mineral formulations.

Bornite and peacock ore have the chemical composition Cu3FeS4 and Cu5FeS4 respectively; copper sulfate is also known as tutthaḥ. In calcinated form tuttha is used as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral formulations.
Bismuth (III) sulfide (Bi2S3). In calcinated form chapala is used as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral formulations.
Zinc carbonate (ZnCo3). In calcinated form rasaka is used as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral formulations.

nodes.label_en: Group of subsidiary substances used in the processing of mercury
nodes.definition: A group of subsidiary substances of mineral and plant origin (subsidiary to the superior minerals) which are complementary to the superior elements in the processing of mercury: gandhaka, gairika, kasisa, kamkshi/sphatika, haritalam, manahshila, anjanam and kankushtam.
Duly processed gandhakam is employed as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo- mineral pharmaceutical formulations.

Sb2S3. Duly processed anjanam is employed as a stand- alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral pharmaceutical formulations.
Bark exudate of Mysore gamboge tree (Garcinia morella (Gaertn.) Desr.).

nodes.label_en: Group of supplement- ary mineral substances

Classification of food items based on their mode of eating or consumption.
Solid food items such as rice, bread, and pancakes which are to be chewed when consumed.
Food items such as juices, milk or buttermilk which are consumed in liquid form.
Semisolid food items such as pastes, jams, and jellies, which are licked when consumed.

Food which requires thorough chewing when consumed.

The group of meats of various animals such as birds, fish.
The group of vegetables comprising leaf, root or tuber, flower, stem and fruit.
In general, fruits that are eaten after they ripen are classified as group of fruits e.g. grapes, pomegranate and mango. Fruits that are eaten raw are classified as a group of vegetables.

The group of vegetables which should be consumed fresh such as salads, leafy vegetables and certain spices: Zingiber officinale Roscoe (ardraka), Raphanus sativus L. (mulaka), Mentha spicata L.(putiha), Coriandrum sativum L.(dhanyaka) or Allium cepa L. (palandu).
Pulses which are beneficial in soup preparations such as green gram.
The group of alcoholic drinks such as wine prepared by fermentation of grains and fruits.

The group of substances derived from sugarcane such as sugarcane juice, jaggery and sugar.
The group of food adjuvants such as types of oil, dry ginger, long pepper (pippali), asafoetida or rock salt.
Generally, denotes cow milk

nodes.label_en: Group of eight types of milk obtained from different sources
nodes.definition: Milk of cow, buffalo, sheep, goat, horse, elephant, camel and humans.
Curds, and the stages of their preparation, from the milk of various animals.

nodes.label_en: Buttermilk prepared by churning curd after removing cream

A type of buttermilk prepared by churning curd with half the amount of water.
A type of buttermilk prepared by churning curd with quarter the amount of water.
The supernatant liquid portion after the formation of curd or buttermilk, mixed with large amount of water.
The solid part of milk obtained through curdling.

A preparation of curd obtained by mixing it with sugar and spices such as pepper.
The supernatant liquid portion of curd.
A type of buttermilk prepared by churning curd without adding water.
Honey produced by various types of honeybee.
A variety of brownish-coloured honey produced by small types of honeybee.
A variety of honey which resembles ghee in colour, produced by larger types of honeybee.
A variety of whitish-coloured honey produced by large black bees.
A variety of honey which resembles oil in colour and produced by tawny honeybees.

nodes.label_en: Group of various types of processed and unprocessed water
nodes.definition: The group of various types of processed and unprocessed water such as rainwater, water from wells, lakes and rivers, coconut water and boiled water.

nodes.label_en: Rainwater before reaching the earth’s surface
nodes.definition: Rainwater collected directly before it touches the earth’s surface and considered the best of all types of water.
Water obtained from rivers and streams.
Water obtained from dewdrops formed at night in the cold season or rainwater accumulating on leaves.
Water which arises naturally from the earth.
Water obtained by melting hailstones
Water obtained from wells.
A type of water which is not contaminated with dust, soot, toxic gases or other environmental impurities.
A type of water which originates from waterfalls in the mountains.

nodes.label_en: Water derived from a spring or fountain
nodes.definition: A type of water obtained from small falls or fountains.
A type of water obtained from step wells.
Surface water which is very prone to contamination with dust, soot, toxic substances, and other environmental impurities.
A type of water obtained from lakes.

nodes.label_en: Water detoxified by exposure to the rays of sun and moon and Canopus star
nodes.definition: Water purified by the rays of the sun and moon and detoxified by the effect of Canopus or “cleanser of waters” star (agastyanakṣatra) which is seen in autumn (sharad ṛtu).
Water formed when ice melts.
Water sourced from artificial tanks or ponds.
The process of cooking by direct or indirect contact with fire or heat.
The process of cooking with the aid of steam.
The method of cooking on a hot pan which is usually made of clay.

nodes.label_en: Processing by retaining for long duration
nodes.definition: A type of food processing which involves keeping food articles for long periods in order to obtain a beneficial modulation of their properties.

nodes.label_en: Processing by use of specific vessels or utensils
nodes.definition: A type of food processing in which the properties of food items are modified by using specific utensils for preparation, eating and storage.
A type of food processing which involves transferring properties by keeping food items in contact with another substance.
A type of processing which involves transforming the properties of a substance by churning.
A type of food preparation in which a sweet substance is coated in batter and fried.

nodes.label_en: Fritter-like preparation with sweet honey stuffing
nodes.definition: A preparation similar to a fritter with sweet stuffing in which honey is additionally mixed and prepared in bolus form.
A group of processed food items such as thin gruel of rice (peya), and boiled rice (odana).

nodes.label_en: Supernatant liquid obtained after draining boiled rice
nodes.definition: The liquid portion of rice prepared by adding 14 parts water to one part rice.

A thin gruel of rice along with its solid portion which is easily digestible and thus increases digestive capacity; it is prepared by adding 14 parts water to one part broken rice and boiling well until all the rice grains become soft.
A rice gruel preparation which contains a greater solid than liquid portion; it is prepared by adding 4 parts water to one part broken rice and boiling until the rice becomes soft.
It is prepared with 5 parts water to one part rice and boiling until the rice becomes soft.
A preparation of roasted grains which is easily digestible.
A thin gruel prepared from parched grains.

nodes.label_en: Liquid portion of parched grain gruel
nodes.definition: The liquid portion of gruel prepared from parched grains

nodes.label_en: Processed liquid portion of parched grain gruel
nodes.definition: The liquid portion of parched grain gruel which is processed with oil or ghee, and spices.
A type of food preparation made from the flour of roasted parched grain by adding water and sugar, and mixing it to the consistency of paste.

nodes.label_en: Type of gruel made from barley

A type of food preparation in which a soup of vegetables and/or pulses is prepared by adding 16 parts water without processing with oil or ghee, and spices.

nodes.label_en: Processed soup of vegetables and/or pulses
nodes.definition: A type of food preparation in which a soup of vegetables and/ or pulses is prepared by adding 16 parts water and processed with oil or ghee, and spices.
A meat soup prepared with larger amount of water.
A meat soup processed with oil or ghee, and spices.
A soup prepared by adding a sour substance.
A soup prepared without adding any sour substance.
A dietetic preparation made by adding sugar and water to the flour of roasted grains such as barley, wheat, Bengal gram or parched rice.
A dietetic preparation made by adding sugar and water to the flour of roasted rice.

nodes.label_en: Flour cake, a type of bread

A type of food preparation made from fried barley.
Varieties of sprouted grains such as green gram or chickpea.
A large round cake composed of ground rice, sugar and sesame, which is cooked in oil.
A deep-fried sweet bread.
A type of sweet cake fried in ghee or oil.

nodes.label_en: Boneless meat prepared with certain condiments

A preparation made from de-husked paddy which is moistened, fried, and then parched and flattened.
A beverage prepared from unripe fruit such as mango, grapes, dates, and jujube by adding sugar and spices.

A preparation with mixed sweet, sour and salty tastes usually made by using the juice of garcinia, falsa fruit and black plum, and adding sugar, black salt, rock salt and a small amount of mustard powder.
Various type of preparations made of sweet, sour, and salty substances.
A sweet semi-liquid preparation that is consumed by licking.
A kind of sour liquid prepared from roots and fruits by first steeping them in oil and salt, then drying them before placing them in water to undergo acetous fermentation.
A specific preparation resulting from a process of fermentation.
A gruel prepared using cereals and pulses (rice and horse gram) which is fermented until it becomes sour.
A type of beverage prepared from sour fruits such as jujube (Ziziphus jujube Mill.).

nodes.label_en: Beverage prepared from roots and sesame
nodes.definition: A type of beverage prepared from roots and sesame.
A food preparation made with rice, green gram, salt, ginger, and asafoetida in appropriate amounts and boiled until the rice becomes soft.
The residue of seeds which have been pressed and ground to extract their oil.

nodes.label_en: Liquid portion of porridge prepared with fried barley

A soup of varying consistency prepared with or without seasoning or condiments.
One of the eight clinical branches of Ayurveda:it deals with the management of generalized systemic diseases.

nodes.label_en: Body or internal fire, denoting all metabolic factors of the body
nodes.definition: All factors responsible for digestion and metabolism or transformation.
A treatment eradicates or normalizes impaired dosha and re- establishes all the dhatu in equilibrium, thereby restoring the normal structure and function of bodily elements.
Cure of disease. Synonym of treatment.
Dietary and behavioural practices helpful in treating disease or maintaining health. Synonym of treatment.
Tool or means by which a disease is cured, and health restored. Synonym of treatment.
Therapeutic measures by which a disease is cured, and health restored. Synonym of treatment.
The therapeutic measures taken to counter the disease state. Synonym of treatment.
Correction of wrong behaviour, leading to disease alleviation. Synonym of treatment.
Process of restoring health. Synonym of treatment.
Wholesome food, all activities such as a daily routine and medications which are conducive to health. Synonym of treatment.
The process by which a disease is warded off or deflected. Synonym of treatment.
A type of therapeutic ritual: treatment of a disease by incantation of appropriate mantra under specified conditions.
A type of therapeutic ritual: treatment of a disease through wearing appropriate gems or precious stones depending on the disease itself.
A type of therapeutic ritual.

nodes.label_en: Offerings to deity excluding animal sacrifice
nodes.definition: A type of therapeutic ritual: treatment of a disease whereby something auspicious is offered to the deity to cure the ailment.

nodes.label_en: Offerings to deity including animal sacrifice
nodes.definition: A type of therapeutic ritual: treatment of a disease whereby an animal is offered to the deity to cure the ailment.

nodes.label_en: Oblations or offerings given through fire
nodes.definition: A type of therapeutic ritual: treatment of a disease through the process of combusting various things as offerings to cure the ailment.
A type of therapeutic ritual: treatment of a disease by following certain rules to cure the ailment.
A type of therapeutic ritual.
A type of therapeutic ritual: treatment of a disease by receivingblessings (aśirvada) to cure the ailment.
A type of therapeutic ritual:treatment of a disease by visiting a holy place to cure the ailment.

nodes.label_en: Structured therapy based on clinical reasoning
nodes.definition: A rational and evidence-based therapeutic intervention within the ambit of human intelligence; one of the treatment classifications which has recourse to modalities such as the administration of medicines, diet and other evidence-based approaches to treat a disease.

nodes.label_en: Proven or evidence- based clinical protocol for management of a disease
nodes.definition: Definitive treatment or permanent remedy to a disease: the term naiṣṭhikīcikitsā is a compound of the two words niṣtha (definitive) and cikitsā (treatment).
Administration of a proper diet for the management of diseases.
Administration of medicines for the management of diseases.
A substance which has a deleterious or adverse effect on health. Antonym of medicine or medication.
One of the two types of hazardous substance which produces an immediate harmful effect after use, e.g. poisoning, burning by fire or cutting with a sharp instrument.

nodes.label_en: Detrimental to health in the long term
nodes.definition: One of the two types of hazardous substance which give rise to disease, e.g. long-term adoption of incompatible food and unhealthy practices.
A medicine or regimen which boosts health in a healthy person; a feature of rejuvenative therapy.
The procedures or medicines used to improve health and longevity.
One of the eight clinical branches of Ayurveda concerned with aphrodisiac use.
A medicine which alleviates a patient’s ailments.
Therapy which aims to mitigate the disease by pacifying dosha (in contrast to purifying therapies, which remove dosha from the body).
Therapeutic protocols can be broadly classified into two: nourishing therapy and depleting therapy.
A procedure of disease alleviation by nourishment of bodily tissues.
A procedure of disease alleviation by depletion of bodily tissues.
A subdividing of therapeutic measures into six categories: br̥ṁhaṇam, snehanam, stambhanam, laṁghanaṁ, svedanam and rūkṣaṇaṁ.

On the seventh day the unwholesome substance should be completely discarded and the wholesome substance continued thereafter. This method is generally employed for de-addiction purposes.

nodes.label_en: Agreeable to nature or natural constitution
nodes.definition: Agreeable to nature or natural constitution; excellence or abundance of suitable qualities: food that is fully compatible with the individual and which is completely digested and accepted by the body.
The consumption of wholesome and unwholesome foods at the same time, e.g. intake of green gram (considered wholesome) and black gram (considered unwholesome).

nodes.label_en: Unsuitable timing and amount of food intake
nodes.definition: Food items that are antagonistic to the structural components; food items which partially agitate dosha without eliminating it and eventually become antagonistic to the structural components.
Non-indulgence in sensual pleasures including sexual activity.
Appropriate indulgence in sensual pleasures including sexual activity (in moderation).
Activities related to the body, senses, mind and speech.

A term covering activities related to diet, lifestyle, work and recreation from the time an individual wakes up through to sleep: it is prescribed in accordance with natural diurnal rhythms and their impact on the human body and mind based on the person’s age, place of habitation and seasonal cycle.
Routine pertaining to diet, daily activities and periodical cleansing which is customized for each season of the year.

nodes.label_en: Transition period be- tween two seasons
nodes.definition: The transitional period between two seasons; it includes the last week of the ending season and first week of the beginning season. The regimen of the ending season has to be discontinued gradually even as the regimen of the new season is introduced gradually.
A cognitive and behavioural regimen to enhance well-being and quality of life.

nodes.note_en: Dryness (Ruksha guna) is a primary classical hallmark of elevated Vata dosha.
Pain (Shula) and stiffness in joints correlate classically with Vata accumulation in Sandhi (joints).
Irregular elimination and dryness in the colon are traditionally governed by Apana Vata.
Restlessness and interrupted sleep reflect the mobile (Chala) and light (Laghu) gunas of Vata.
Burning sensations (Daha) are classical hallmark expressions of Ushna (hot) and Tikshna (sharp) Pitta.
Sour regurgitation and hyperacidity correspond classically to Amla Pitta and impaired Pachaka Pitta.
Unquenchable thirst (Trishna) is attributed to elevated metabolic heat (Ushna guna of Pitta).
Sluggish digestion reflects Manda Agni, classical impairment linked to excessive Guru and Snigdha gunas of Kapha.
General heaviness (Gaurava) and excessive lethargy (Alasya) are foundational markers of elevated Kapha.
Accumulation of phlegm and mucosal congestion indicate localized increase of Kledaka or Avalambaka Kapha.
